Hénon Map Trajectory

Source: R/data.R
henon_ts.Rd

A two-dimensional time series generated from the Hénon map with parameters a = 1.4 and b = 0.3, demonstrating chaotic attractor behavior.

Usage

henon_ts

Format

A data frame with 3000 rows and 2 variables:

x

x-coordinate of the trajectory

y

y-coordinate of the trajectory

Source

Generated using simulate_henon_map(n = 3000, a = 1.4, b = 0.3, x0 = 0.1, y0 = 0.1)

Details

Generated using the Hénon map equations: x[n+1] = 1 - a * x[n]^2 + y[n] y[n+1] = b * x[n] with a = 1.4, b = 0.3, and initial conditions (x_0, y_0) = (0.1, 0.1).

Examples

data(henon_ts)
plot(henon_ts$x, henon_ts$y, pch = ".", main = "Hénon Attractor")

plot(henon_ts$x[1:500], type = "l", main = "Hénon Map x-component")
